notes: The spec says the expanded argument must evaluate to a list or tuple, whose elements each map to a parameter, but not what a null does; passing no arguments would also be reasonable. The null keyword is a null of the dynamic pseudo-type, which hashicorp/hcl otherwise accepts for expansion (expanding the dynamic value gives the dynamic value), so only being null makes it fail. hashicorp/hcl reports an error for a null expanded argument (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
reference_error: The expanding argument (indicated by ...) must not be null
